ashwin: noticed a handful of Vault transit unwraps in europe-west1 at ~11:17 UTC that don't have matching KMS audit entries.

maria: can you paste one sample and the query you ran?

ashwin: sample from vault audit (redacted): `2026-08-12T11:17:05Z transit/unwrap id=cty-f4b2 key=europe-west1/wrap-key v=2`. Query: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricDecrypt" timestamp>"2026-08-12T11:00:00Z"` returned only other regions.

tanvi: forwarder logs show a reconnection and one partition skip for europe-west1 around 11:16-11:18. likely a forwarder gap rather than IAM.

sec-oncall: actions: 1) snapshot audit export (done by auditor-bot), 2) attempt replay of offsets, 3) if replay fails for specific records, map ciphertext -> secret path and schedule targeted rewrap/rotation for high-sensitivity entries.

auditor-bot: backup snapshot created gs://redwood-audit-backups/2026-08-12/4123456789-snap.json.

maria: good. tanvi, please map the missing unwrap ids and DM owners for any partner creds. ashwin, hold rewrap until owners confirm. file INFRA follow-up to add retry queue for forwarder decode errors.

(END)
